claims.text: FDA boxed warning for a possible link with malignancy, though there is no firm evidence of one
claims.quote: Topical calcineurin inhibitors include an FDA boxed warning because of the possible association between the medications and malignancies, despite no firm evidence that there is a link.

claims.text: Pimecrolimus 1% or tacrolimus 0.1% are safe and effective on the face or body; recommended when other treatment fails or to avoid long-term corticosteroids (SORT A)
claims.quote: Topical calcineurin inhibitors (eg, pimecrolimus 1%, tacrolimus 0.1%), which are safe and effective treatments for seborrheic dermatitis of the face or body, are recommended in cases that are unresponsive to other treatments or to avoid the consequences of long-term corticosteroid use.2,13,14,23–26 | | A
